amendmentReason: The operator selected Xiaomi MiMo v2.5 before implementation and before any paid API call or LLM outcome existed.
purpose: Estimate action-validity, failure rates, cost, latency, and paired effect variance before fixing the confirmatory LLM-agent sample size.

promptPolicies.priority: satisfy hard constraints, then maximize task utility
inspect recommendation-supported alternatives while respecting hard constraints

selectionRule: lowest stable task hashes among v2-eligible tasks, fixed before API calls
pilotRecommenderAllocation: one balanced model-seed pair per task, crossed across category and task hash

requestPolicy.temperature: provider default; not overridden for MiMo v2.5 Responses calls
requestPolicy.cache: content-addressed raw responses under ignored artifacts
requestPolicy.privacy: send pseudonymous candidate IDs and derived task features only; never send titles, reviews, original IDs, or histories

goGates.sampleSizeRule: use the largest task-cluster SD across model-by-prompt cells to target a 0.05 CI half-width; cap only after reporting the unconstrained requirement

costGate: Do not issue paid API calls until MIMO_API_KEY is present and the operator explicitly accepts the dry-run request and token estimate.
claimBoundary: This pilot tests model-mediated action selection in a pseudonymous research storefront. It is not computer-use on Amazon.com and cannot establish human behavior.
